subject: Request: one-time trial augmentation & short-term discount for NPI Health
messages:
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@npihealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: alan.reyes@npihealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial follow-up and ask: additional credits + short discount?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — Alan and I ran an internal smoke test over the weekend and we’re seeing promising signal on both intent extraction and routing latency. To move a small pilot into a broader clinical workflow sandbox (additional 6 teams, heavier prompts), we need to extend the trial runway and add token credits beyond our initial allocation.

Concretely: would Redwood consider a one-time augmentation of trial credits (~$10k equivalent) for an extra 45 days, plus a temporary 10% platform usage discount during that period? Procurement prefers this be captured as a short addendum rather than a full contract amendment.

We’re trying to finalize a vendor recommendation by 11/30; this extra runway would let us validate throughput and compliance hooks (audit logs, KMS patterns). Happy to jump on a call if useful.

Best,
Samantha Jones
Head of ML Ops, NPI Health

Attachments: NPI-Health-Usage-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: samantha.jones@npihealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial follow-up and ask: additional credits + short discount?

Marissa / Laura — forwarding NPI’s ask. Summary: they want a one-time ~$10k credit top-up and a 45-day extension with a temporary 10% usage discount. They will capture acceptance as a brief addendum (procurement wants simple language).

Why I’m flagging: NPI is strategically attractive (regional hospital network, potential Dedicated commit in H2 if pilot scales). Signal looks strong but we’re outside standard PLG limits for free credits. Can we get deal desk guidance / exec signoff for this one-time concession? If it helps, they agreed to a short checkpoints/cadence and a success metric (>=2 integrated teams, <50ms p99 extranet latency on routing) as acceptance criteria.

Attachments: NPI-Health-Usage-Plan.xlsx

Thanks — Karthik
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial follow-up and ask: additional credits + short discount?

Karthik — good catch. Quick points:
- Deal economics: $10k in free credits for 45 days vs. a likely $60k ARR if they convert to Dedicated within 9–12 months (based on their stated footprint).
- Risk controls: require a short success checklist + milestone sign-off from our CS lead; credits consumed only on the verified sandbox project (we can gate by project id and billing tags).
- Discount: 10% for 45 days is modest; prefer to apply as a usage credit (rather than reduce list price) so it’s reversible and easier to track.

I recommend we escalate to Rishi for one-off exec approval with these controls. Laura — can you draft the addendum language that captures the credit amount, duration, milestone acceptance criteria, and a clause that revokes credits if audit logs show misuse? If Rishi signs off I’ll communicate to NPI and loop in legal for a short addendum.

Marissa
VP, Sales
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: samantha.jones@npihealth.com, alan.reyes@npihealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: NPI Health one-time trial augmentation (exec consent)

Marissa / Karthik / Laura — after reviewing the ask and expected upside, I approve a one-time trial augmentation as outlined below:

Approved items (one-off):
- $10,000 in trial credits applied to account HSP-2026-0927, active for 45 days from the date of addendum execution.
- A 10% usage credit applied during the same 45-day window (implemented as a post-billing credit).

Conditions (must be included in addendum):
1) Success criteria: at least 2 integrated clinical teams running the sandbox workflow and <50ms p99 routing latency as measured by Redwood Console by day 40.
2) Credits are limited to the sandbox project id specified in the addendum; any credits consumed outside that project will be reclaimed.
3) Provision of requested SOC2 evidence (redacted) and completion of our standard onboarding security checklist before credits activate.
4) If onboarding stalls >30 days after activation start, credits will be paused pending a joint checkpoint call.

Laura — please draft the addendum using the above, route to Legal for a short review and loop Procurement at NPI for signature. Marissa / Karthik, I authorize you to communicate this decision and negotiate minor timeline clarifications, but any increase to credit or discount requires an additional exec sign-off.

Rishi
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: NPI-Health-Trial-Statement-v3.pdf (for legal scope)
